six_way_tie.scope: Synthetic equal-score records; actual select_models control, no formal training or calibration/final predictions.
six_way_tie.selection_rule: highest dev paired accuracy, then mean missing-cue accuracy, then earlier checkpoint, then job_order. All six final runs reported, never select on final.
